Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 019. 最多删除一个字符得到回文

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    bool validPalindrome(string s) {
        auto check = [&](int i, int j) {
            for (; i < j; ++i, --j) {
                if (s[i] != s[j]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        };
        for (int i = 0, j = s.size() - 1; i < j; ++i, --j) {
            if (s[i] != s[j]) {
                return check(i + 1, j) || check(i, j - 1);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};
